post.description: Discovery: find products by keyword or browse a category (e.g. "Graphics Cards|518") for a given store_id. Use lookup_by_sku for a known SKU and get_product for full details.

category.description: Category facet as the site writes it in fq=category:{Name}|{id}, e.g. "Graphics Cards|518" or "Computer Parts|94".

in_store_only.description: true (default): only items in stock at store_id (myStore=true). false: include out-of-stock and not-carried items.

page.description:
1-based page; default 1. Use next_page from the previous call.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500.

per_page.description:
Results per page; default 24.

Provider reference: allowed values ["24", "48", "96"].

query.description: Keyword search (Ntt). Optional when category is given.

sort.description:
Sort order; default match.

Provider reference: allowed values ["match", "pricelow", "pricehigh", "rating", "numreviews", "newest"].

store_id.description: 3-digit zero-padded store number (045 St. Louis Park, 205 Phoenix, 141 Columbus). Default 029 = Shippable Items (web pricing, no store inventory). list_stores returns the ids. Pattern: ^[0-9]{3}$.

200.description:
Search Micro Center products by keyword and/or category facet for one store. Each result carries the store's displayed price, inventory count and in-store/online restriction. Default in_store_only=true limits results to items stocked at the store, as the site does.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `availability_message` | string | The stock line as printed: IN STOCK, NEW IN STOCK, NOT CARRIED, SOLD OUT, ... |
| `brand` | string |  |
| `category` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `image_url` | string |  |
| `in_stock` | boolean |  |
| `inventory_count` | number | Units the page reports at the store ("25+" is reported as 25); null when no count is shown. |
| `member_savings` | number | Additional member-pricing savings in USD when the tile advertises one; null otherwise. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `price` | number | Displayed store price in USD; null when the page shows none (e.g. NOT CARRIED at this store). |
| `product_id` | string |  |
| `purchase_restriction` | string | e.g. "In Store Only" when the item cannot be shipped. |
| `sku` | string |  |
| `store_name` | string |  |
| `url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
